definitions.explanation: The classical Japanese dance form that developed from kabuki and noh, performed in kimono to {三味線|しゃみせん} or {長唄|ながうた} music. Often shortened to {日舞|にちぶ} when spoken among practitioners.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{日本舞踊|にほんぶよう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}っている→習う：00479_narau⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother studies Japanese traditional dance.

examples.japanese: {日本舞踊|にほんぶよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発表会|はっぴょうかい}→発表会：27716_happyoukai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to see a Japanese traditional dance recital.

examples.japanese: {日本舞踊|にほんぶよう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{流派|りゅうは}→流派：13365_ryuuha⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{動|うご}き→動き：11926_ugoki⟧や⟦{衣装|いしょう}→衣装：14102_ishou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧。
examples.english: Japanese traditional dance varies greatly in movement and costume depending on the school.

notes:
Organized into hereditary schools (⟦{流派|りゅうは}→流派：13365_ryuuha⟧) such as {花柳|はなやぎ}, {藤間|ふじま}, and {若柳|わかやぎ}. Lessons emphasize precise posture, restrained gesture, and synchronization with sung music.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日本舞踊|にほんぶよう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}う→習う：00479_narau⟧: to study Japanese dance
- {日本舞踊|にほんぶよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{師匠|ししょう}→師匠：12421_shishou⟧: dance teacher
- {日本舞踊|にほんぶよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{流派|りゅうは}→流派：13365_ryuuha⟧: school of Japanese dance
- {日本舞踊|にほんぶよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{舞台|ぶたい}→舞台：03606_butai⟧: Japanese dance stage performance

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{歌舞伎|かぶき}→歌舞伎：04455_kabuki⟧⟦{舞踊|ぶよう}→舞踊：05410_buyou⟧: kabuki dance — the stage dance tradition that fed into nihon-buyō
- {日舞|にちぶ}: shortened form used among practitioners
- {舞|まい}: a broader term for traditional dance, including noh dance
